relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein (NLRP) 3 inflammasome can promote bone resorption through the activation of the proinflammatory cytokines interleukin (IL)-1β, IL-18 and the induction of caspase-1-mediated pyroptosis

key_findings: Review: NLRP3 inflammasome promotes bone resorption around implants via IL-1β, IL-18 and caspase-1-mediated pyroptosis.
Metal particles and microorganisms around implants can activate NLRP3; NLRP3 is proposed as a target against peri-implantitis.
